name: Professional Scrum Master I
name_ja: プロフェッショナル・スクラムマスター I

logistics.format: Online open-book multiple-choice / multiple-answer / true-false assessment; passing score 85%

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded recognized framework and accessible entry assessment support foundational delivery-process knowledge; no experience and limited depth do not establish professional team leadership or security capability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A recognized framework and defined passing threshold provide foundational Scrum knowledge. Zero experience and an open-book objective exam leave actual delivery leadership and technical security capability unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded open-entry, objective Scrum assessment provides introductory framework literacy. It has no technical-security assessment or evidence of actual delivery responsibility.
